title: echelon.routes/v1 route inventory
description: Every addressable view of a web application, its parameters and their encoding (SAF-URL-8). Limen owns this document: Inventory.render (F#) and renderRouteInventory (TypeScript) write it (Limen LCP-107), and Limen publishes the canonical schema as contract/routes.schema.json in @echelon-foundry/limen (LCP-108). This file mirrors that contract as fixed in Limen DF-LIMEN-2026-0006, so a repository can be checked without Limen installed; once Limen 0.9.0 publishes its schema, this file is replaced by a byte-for-byte copy of it. Changes within v1 are additive, so unknown properties are allowed.

mode.description: hash: the route follows #/ (index.html#/invoices/42?tab=history), for static hosts such as GitHub Pages; path: for hosts that answer every path with the application (SAF-URL-6, DF-LIMEN-2026-0006).

home.description: Full name of the home route.

signIn.description: Full name of the sign-in route, or null.

notFound.description: Full name of the not-found route, or null.

legacy.description: Old URLs that redirect to a current route (SAF-URL-7, Limen LCP-105).

name.description: Full, dotted route name, e.g. invoices.invoice.history.

pattern.description: Path pattern with {name} or {name:type} placeholders, e.g. /invoices/{id:int}/history. Query parameters are declared in params, not written into the pattern.

params.description: Parent first, in declaration order: the canonical URL writes query parameters in this order and omits any equal to its default (SAF-URL-2).

guard.description: Name of the engine guard, an interface decision, not authorization.

requires.description: Resources the view needs before it can resolve.

returnTarget.description: Whether sign-in may return to this route (SAF-URL-1).

name.description: Never a name reserved for credentials (SAF-URL-5, Limen LCP-109).

type.description: int: decimal within ±(2^53-1); date: YYYY-MM-DD; month: YYYY-MM; set: sorted, de-duplicated, comma-joined. Path parameters use string, int, date, month or enum.

default.description: Query parameters only; omitted from the canonical URL when equal.

values.description: The values of an enum or set.

to.description: Full name of the current route.
